run_rerank_cohere: run litellm rerank with cohere model to rank documents by relevance score
run_async_rerank: run async litellm arerank to rerank documents against a query using cohere
test_rerank_response_shape: test the rerank response shape by asserting id results and meta fields
test_rerank_custom_callbacks: test rerank with a custom logger callback to capture kwargs and response objects
test_rerank_caching: test rerank caching behavior by calling rerank twice and checking cache key presence
